run_culturax_pipeline: run the datatrove SlurmPipelineExecutor to download and convert CulturaX parquet data to jsonl
create_parquet_reader: create a ParquetReader that reads from hf://datasets/uonlp/CulturaX with a glob pattern and custom adapter
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that outputs language-partitioned jsonl.gz files with rank-based filenames
build_slurm_executor: build a SlurmPipelineExecutor with 1000 tasks, 4GB per CPU, and a 20-hour time limit on a partition
test_adapter_function: test the adapter function that transforms raw data dicts into datatrove Document format with text, id, media, and metadata
